line.en: Tell it once. It gets on with it.

goal.en: A personal agent for the Mac: it takes the task, writes down what “done” means, works in the background and asks before it touches anything. Approve from the Mac or from your iPhone.
goal.zh: Mac 上的个人 Agent：接下任务，先写清怎样算完成，在后台去做，动你的东西之前先问你。在 Mac 或 iPhone 上都能批准。

title.en: Work on the Mac, approve from your iPhone.
title.zh: 活在 Mac 上干，批准在 iPhone 上点

title.en: The Island: what it's doing, in the notch.
title.zh: Island：它在做什么，就在刘海里

line.en: How much caffeine might be left at bedtime?

goal.en: Make the relationship between logged caffeine and a chosen bedtime easier to understand through a simple estimate.
goal.zh: 让记录下来的咖啡因与计划入睡时间之间的关系，更容易被理解。

goal.en: Keep the same moment understandable across cities, including time differences and daily context.
goal.zh: 让同一个时刻在不同城市的含义，随时清楚可见。

title.en: Keep the same rhythm after dark.

line.en: Practise what you’d say in a real conversation.
line.zh: 练习真实场景里的那一句。

goal.en: Help a learner complete a realistic language task, receive useful feedback, and bring weak expressions back into later practice.
goal.zh: 把真实生活里的语言任务，变成准备、尝试、反馈和再次练习的完整过程。

title.en: Know what you’re trying to do.

line.en: Move the symbols. Change the rules.

goal.en: Turn mathematical symbols into objects and rules that a player can use to cross a spatial puzzle.
goal.zh: 让数学符号成为可摆放、可触发的规则，用它们走过一个空间谜题。

goal.en: Travel with Nume through a world of paper, numbers, and small acts of care. Mathematical changes take physical shape in the things you touch.
goal.zh: 与 Nume 一起，穿过由纸张、数字与小小善意组成的世界。数学的变化，落在真实可触摸的事物上。

line.en: Move, merge, summon. What’s your next turn?
line.zh: 走棋、合并、召唤。下一步怎么选？

goal.en: Combine chess-like movement, merging and summoning in a paper-theatre campaign with readable tactical consequences.
goal.zh: 把走棋、合并和召唤放进纸剧场，用清楚的回合结果呈现战术。

line.en: Plan the water’s route. See how the day unfolds.
line.zh: 安排一段水路，看它怎样改变一天。

goal.en: Make water scheduling understandable as a turn-based puzzle of supply, timing and consequence.
goal.zh: 把水的供应、时间和后果，变成可以反复推敲的回合制谜题。

line.zh: 研究有上下文，回答有出处。

goal.en: Bring portfolio context, market data and an AI research assistant together while keeping the source and timing of claims visible.
goal.zh: 让研究问题、投资组合和市场资料放在一起，并保留答案的来源与时间。

line.en: Leave a voice note. Come back to it later.
line.zh: 留下一段声音，隔些日子再听。

goal.en: Create a place to speak, keep a moment, and revisit it without confusing a person’s original words with a generated reply.
goal.zh: 留下一段当下，也能够在以后回来看看，并分清原话与生成的回应。

title.zh: 留下一段可回访的记忆

line.en: Record what you spent, and how it felt.
line.zh: 记下花了什么，也记下当时的感受。

goal.en: Pair a personal ledger with gentle reflection on how everyday spending feels.
goal.zh: 在个人账本之外，给日常消费的感受留一点位置。

line.zh: 通过对话，理清一笔笔支出。

goal.en: Let a person record spending and revisit money context through a conversation.
goal.zh: 通过对话记下一笔消费，也通过对话重新理解账本。

title.en: Keep the exchange in one place.

line.zh: 同一本账，区分两个人的支出。

goal.en: Give two people a shared way to discuss everyday spending, with room for ownership and personal context.
goal.zh: 让两个人一起看待日常支出，同时保留各自的归属与感受。

title.en: Add a moment to the ledger.
Leave room for a little warmth.

line.en: Exploring how health and food fit into the day.
line.zh: 试着把健康与饮食的线索放在一起。

goal.en: Bring daily health signals and meal context into a more connected wellness reflection.
goal.zh: 把每日健康信号与饮食记录联系起来，为生活状态提供更多上下文。

line.en: Continue your research on your phone.

goal.en: Make Alfred’s research conversation and portfolio context accessible through a native mobile interface.
goal.zh: 在手机上继续 Alfred 的研究对话，并随时查看相关上下文。

line.en: From a receipt to a reviewed record.
line.zh: 从一张票据，到核对后的一笔记录。

goal.en: Make everyday financial records easier to capture, organize and review, including a reviewable path from an image to suggested transactions.
goal.zh: 让日常财务记录更容易被录入和整理，包括从图片提取、经确认后入账的过程。

line.en: Another way back to a photo.
line.zh: 换一条线索，重新找到照片。

goal.en: Make a personal photo collection easier to browse, relate and organize through local metadata and image analysis.
goal.zh: 借助本地元数据与图像分析，让个人照片更容易被浏览、关联和整理。

line.en: A poem you can wander into.

goal.en: Make a poem something a person can move through, using space, sound and an unhurried interaction.
goal.zh: 把诗变成可以走进去的地方，让空间、声音和缓慢的移动一起叙事。
